ice.text: Kaysa, a moon-marked girl, shelters from a storm in Mikkel's church with Halvor, until Elder Druid Kolbjörn arrives to take her to Fyndhorn, though Halvor objects.
When the undead villagers break into the church, Kolbjörn and Kaysa chant the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of their life and saving the group.
With Halvor's consent, she goes with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn and is raised as the couple's adopted daughter.
Later Freyalise asks Kaysa to help cast her greatest spell, admitting she cannot guarantee the child's safety, and the World Spell breaks the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.
